prompt: Hey — tonight's the overnight quant pipeline run and I need you to get our watchdog monitoring set up before the 01:00 UTC gateway maintenance window. The full situation is documented in /workspace/ops/runbooks/overnight_ops_runbook.txt — please read it carefully because there are specific details about which jobs to watch, which job got cancelled mid-run, where their PID files and output locations are, and what notification target to use tonight (it's NOT the default one). The gateway maintenance restart also needs to be pre-registered with the watchdog, using the same notification target as the jobs. Once everything is set up, write a file called monitoring_report.json into /workspace/ops/monitoring/ that summarises the active job registrations, whether the gateway restart is registered, the notification target you used, and any jobs that were removed. The overnight automation will check that file.
